closedDefects.defect: Store Append did not validate eventId against the canonical identity
closedDefects.correction: both append and replay enforce eventId === associationEventId(canonical identity) for the validated payload
tests: P2C C2 §6.3 a non-canonical eventId is refused on append

closedDefects.defect: Store Replay never read row.attempt_id, so a mutated column was invisible
closedDefects.correction: parseStoredEvent compares row.project_id and row.attempt_id against the payload and fails closed on a mismatch
tests: P2C C2 §6.4 a row whose columns contradict the payload fails closed on replay

properties: typed strict payload validation before any write
same eventId with different content fails closed (event_conflict)
byte-identical duplicate delivery is an idempotent no-op
malformed stored record fails closed on replay, never reads as an empty history
the canonical identity check runs on BOTH append and replay

multiCandidatePreservation.behavior: three distinct Session identities for one invocation are all preserved as separate durable records
multiCandidatePreservation.test: test/trajectory_p2b_adversarial_matrix.test.ts 'three distinct identities remain THREE candidates after a restart'
